name: llama Router
author: ducn
description: Status for a llama.cpp router server: how many models are up, which GPU each one sits on, the port answering for it and the speed it last served, with start/stop/restart of the systemd user unit behind it.

barWidget.description: Shows how many models a llama.cpp router keeps loaded, the card each one sits on, the port serving it and the token/s it last served for prompt processing and generation. Start / Stop / Restart drive a systemd user unit.

schema.label: Router URL
schema.description: Base URL of the llama.cpp router server (the one started with --models-preset). Only /models and /props are read.

schema.label: Systemd user unit
schema.description: User unit that runs start_server.sh. Start / Stop / Restart call systemctl --user on it.

schema.label: Bar readout
schema.description: count is the number of loaded models, device lists one short tag per card holding a model (CUDA0 -> c0), name spells out the loaded models, off keeps only the icon. Right-clicking the widget cycles these.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Icon glyph for the widget. U+E900..U+E90F are drawn with the omarchy brand font (default U+E907, the ollama llama); any other codepoint is a Nerd Font glyph in the bar font.

schema.label: List idle models too
schema.description: Add a section to the popup for models the router knows about but has not loaded.
